intro: Dear Obit Billionaires, join us in this morning prayer. Repeat after me.
lines: I am grateful for life and the gift of this new day.
I enter this day with faith, courage and a clear mind.
May the work of my hands prosper through wise and honest decisions.
Open my eyes to honest opportunities to earn and grow.
I welcome money earned through useful work, skill and service.
Today, I speak wisdom, provision and favour over my life.
My mind is ready to learn, create and solve real problems.
I have something useful to offer, and I will offer it well.
May I meet people who value the work I do.
Let my words be clear and my promises be honest.
I give my time to work that deserves my attention.
I meet this day prepared to recognise and use good opportunities.
May I turn my ideas into useful and lasting work.
I release the fear that keeps me from taking a sensible step.
I am willing to begin small and build with patience.
I choose steady progress over the pressure to appear successful.
May I have wisdom to manage every naira entrusted to me.
I keep clear records of what I earn, spend and owe.
I can enjoy today while preparing carefully for tomorrow.
I practise saving, thoughtful spending and respect for my obligations.
May I recognise fraud, avoid reckless choices and turn away from dishonest gain.
I do not need to cheat another person to make progress.
My character matters as much as the money I seek.
I welcome fair payment and fair dealings in my work.
May I have courage to ask clearly for what my work is worth.
Help me serve my customers, colleagues and community with care.
I can improve my skills and increase the value I bring.
Yesterday's disappointment does not close every door before me today.
I speak hope over my plans and discipline over my actions.
May my needs be met, and may I use every provision well.
Give me strength to face financial difficulties with honesty and patience.
Help me seek sound advice before making important money decisions.
I make room for generosity without neglecting my responsibilities.
I am grateful for each honest opportunity to earn and contribute.
Today, I will take one clear step towards a stronger financial life.
May peace, provision and good judgement guide my day, my work and my household.

intro: Dear Obit Billionaires, join us in this work hour prayer. Repeat after me.
lines: I return to my work with a clear and willing mind.
I have strength for the next useful step before me.
May my energy be renewed and my thoughts be steady this afternoon.
I release distraction and give this moment my full attention.
I can do meaningful work without carrying every worry at once.
My effort has purpose, and I choose to continue with courage.
I bring patience, honesty and care to the work I do.
One task at a time, I make room for real progress.
May I see what matters and begin with that.
I do not have to finish everything to do something well.
I can pause, breathe and return with a clearer mind.
A difficult morning does not have to decide my whole day.
May wisdom guide me where the next step is unclear.
Help me ask the right questions and listen to useful answers.
I welcome correction that helps me become better at my work.
I can learn a new skill and practise it with patience.
May those who work beside me and those I serve find strength.
Let my words bring clarity, respect and encouragement to others.
I choose cooperation where pride would make the work harder.
I keep my promises and communicate honestly when plans change.
May my frustration settle, and may I respond with good judgement.
I can face a problem without speaking defeat over my life.
I have permission to rest briefly and protect my strength.
I return from rest ready to give my work careful attention.
May I be safe in every task, journey and place of work.
Help me use my tools, my time and my abilities responsibly.
I will not measure my whole life by another person's pace.
I can be grateful for progress that others do not see.
May those looking for work and those learning a trade find encouragement.
Give courage to those beginning again after disappointment or loss.
I bring hope into this afternoon through the way I act.
I can complete one useful task before this working day ends.
May honest effort bear fruit even when recognition is slow to come.
Help me leave my work in a better state than I found it.
I move forward with focus, patience and a willing heart.
May my strength be renewed, and may I meet the rest of this day with peace.

intro: Dear Obit Billionaires, join us in this bedtime prayer. Repeat after me.
lines: I am grateful to have reached the close of this day.
As I lie down, may peace settle over my heart.
Watch over my home and everyone resting under this roof.
Keep us from danger and grant us a quiet night.
I release the worries I cannot settle tonight and welcome rest.
May my body find strength, my mind find calm and my spirit find renewal.
May I learn from my wrongs and find peace with those who have hurt me.
Let anger, bitterness and fear lose their hold on my heart.
May my thoughts rest from the troubles I cannot settle tonight.
Help me leave unfinished work until it is time to begin again.
Give me rest that refreshes me for the responsibilities of tomorrow.
Let my sleep be peaceful and my waking be filled with gratitude.
May my family find health, strength and comfort.
Be close to everyone facing pain, illness or a difficult diagnosis.
Give wisdom to their doctors and care to those supporting them.
Help us seek and receive the treatment and support we need.
May those who are anxious or alone tonight find comfort.
Bring reassurance to homes troubled by fear, sorrow or uncertainty.
Watch over children, older people and those who cannot protect themselves.
Strengthen caregivers and everyone keeping watch while others are asleep.
May those travelling or working through the night have clarity and safe passage.
Help them remain alert, make wise choices and return home safely.
Protect our homes from harm and guide us in practical care.
Help us notice danger and take sensible steps to keep one another safe.
May hope return where this day has brought disappointment.
May I recognise goodness even while parts of my life remain unfinished.
I release the need to understand everything before I can rest.
I receive this night with gratitude and a trusting heart.
May my spiritual life bring sincerity, compassion and peace.
Give me a clean heart, a gentle tongue and a teachable spirit.
Lead me away from choices that harm me or another person.
Fill my home with kindness, patience and care for one another.
May I meet tomorrow with wisdom and courage.
Whatever tomorrow brings, help me face it one step at a time.
I lie down in peace and welcome the quiet of this night.
May this night bring protection, health, comfort and peaceful rest.
